title: The Drawing Kept on the Fridge Square
youtube_title: The Drawing Kept on the Fridge Square | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A thank-you that takes effort feels true.
summary: At a library corner with a paper ribbon in a book, Lior notices that Mr. Ade has already taken care of a drawing kept, not replaced, on the square of the fridge. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Lior does one useful thing Mr. Ade did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
